facts.summary: Wind down of trial, 60% layoffs, strategic alternatives explored · Phase 1/2 · TCR-T Library in metastatic solid tumors · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Company to wind down TCR-T Library Phase 1/2 trial and concurrently explore potential partnering opportunities for the hunTR® platform as well as broad strategic alternatives
evidence.safety: The trial showed that the Company’s T-cells were generally well-tolerated in all evaluable participants
evidence.program_discontinued: Alaunos has decided to wind down its TCR-T Library Phase 1/2 trial and prioritize the hunTR® platform to explore potential partnering opportunities.
